title.en: Google launches Gemini 2.0 with Project Mariner, unveiling its vision for an AI agent ecosystem
title.zhHans: Google 发布 Gemini 2.0 及 Project Mariner，展示 AI 智能体生态愿景

summary.en: On December 11, 2024, Google DeepMind launched Gemini 2.0, its 'agentic era' AI model, alongside three agent projects: Project Mariner (browser agent), Project Astra (universal assistant prototype), and Jules (coding agent). The launch signalled Google's formal entry into the AI agent race, bringing agent-native capabilities to billions of users through Google's existing product ecosystem.
summary.zhHans: 2024 年 12 月 11 日，Google DeepMind 发布了 Gemini 2.0——其"智能体时代"AI 模型——同时推出三个智能体项目：Project Mariner（浏览器智能体）、Project Astra（通用助手原型）和 Jules（编程智能体）。此次发布标志着 Google 正式进入 AI 智能体竞赛，通过 Google 现有产品生态将智能体原生能力带给数十亿用户。

narrative.en: Google's Gemini 2.0 launch represented a pivotal moment in the agent AI race. While OpenAI and Anthropic had been first to market with agents (Operator, Computer Use), Google's entry brought unique advantages: a pre-existing product ecosystem spanning search, email, documents, maps, and YouTube, plus a user base of billions. Gemini 2.0 was designed as an 'agentic era' model from the ground up — supporting multimodal input, tool use, and autonomous task execution natively. The three agent projects demonstrated different aspects: Project Mariner could browse the web and fill forms autonomously (operating directly in the browser); Project Astra was a universal assistant research prototype that could see, hear, and interact with the physical world; and Jules was a coding agent integrated into Google's development tools. The launch was widely covered as Google's 'coming out party' for AI agents. While Project Mariner was later shut down in 2026 (as a research prototype that served its purpose), the Gemini 2.0 platform itself became Google's foundation for agent-native features across Search, Assistant, and Workspace. The launch was significant not just for what it did, but for what it represented: the largest platform company in the world was now betting its future on AI agents, not just chatbots. For users, it meant that agent capabilities were becoming embedded in the tools they already used daily, rather than requiring a separate product.
narrative.zhHans: Google 的 Gemini 2.0 发布代表了智能体 AI 竞赛中的一个关键节点。虽然 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 在智能体方面率先进入市场（Operator、Computer Use），但 Google 的加入带来了独特的优势：一个涵盖搜索、邮件、文档、地图和 YouTube 的现有产品生态系统，以及数十亿用户。Gemini 2.0 从头开始被设计为"智能体时代"模型——原生支持多模态输入、工具使用和自主任务执行。三个智能体项目展示了不同方面：Project Mariner 可以自主浏览网页和填写表单（直接在浏览器中操作）；Project Astra 是一个通用助手研究原型，可以看、听并与物理世界交互；Jules 是一个集成在 Google 开发工具中的编程智能体。这次发布被广泛报道为 Google 的 AI 智能体"亮相派对"。虽然 Project Mariner 后来在 2026 年被关闭（作为完成了使命的研究原型），但 Gemini 2.0 平台本身成为 Google 在搜索、助手和 Workspace 中构建智能体原生功能的基础。这次发布的重要性不仅在于它做了什么，更在于它代表什么：全球最大的平台公司现在将其未来押注在 AI 智能体上，而不仅仅是聊天机器人。对用户而言，这意味着智能体能力正在嵌入他们已经日常使用的工具中，而不需要单独的产品。

description.en: First mainstream platform to natively support multimodal input, tool use, and autonomous execution in a single model. Brought agent capabilities to the billions of users in Google's ecosystem.
description.zhHans: 首个原生支持多模态输入、工具使用和自主执行的单一模型的主流平台。将智能体能力带给 Google 生态中的数十亿用户。

description.en: Signal that the largest platform company in the world was betting on AI agents, not just chatbots. Agent capabilities becoming embedded in everyday tools, not requiring separate products.
description.zhHans: 表明全球最大的平台公司押注于 AI 智能体，而不仅仅是聊天机器人。智能体能力正在嵌入日常工具，不需要单独产品。

text.en: Google launched Gemini 2.0 on December 11, 2024, alongside Project Mariner (browser agent), Project Astra (universal assistant), and Jules (coding agent).
text.zhHans: Google 于 2024 年 12 月 11 日发布了 Gemini 2.0，同时推出了 Project Mariner（浏览器智能体）、Project Astra（通用助手）和 Jules（编程智能体）。

sources.quote: Introducing Gemini 2.0, our new AI model for the agentic era.
